name: app-maxwell-filtering
summary: Placeholder App holding only an MNE-Python example script for Maxwell filtering (tSSS with movement compensation) of MEG data; it has no main script, inputs or outputs and cannot run.
description: The repository contains a single script, 03-maxwell_filtering.py, copied from an MNE-Python group study example that Maxwell-filters the ds117 dataset with tSSS and movement compensation and low-pass filters at 40 Hz, using paths from a local library.config module. There is no main file and no inputs, outputs or parameters are registered, so the App cannot be executed on brainlife.io.
